integrity: All Birkhoff unit pairs are reduced to an exact two-variable rational optimization. Three sign regions are eliminated algebraically; the remaining semialgebraic region has one interior critical point, certified by a factored resultant, Sturm root isolation, a linear subresultant, and exact boundary analysis. The bundled checker replays these certificates. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes \(\mu_3\) only for the real two-dimensional \(\ell_3^2\) plane. It does not determine the arbitrary-dimensional \(\ell_3\) value or a full-exponent law.
title: Exact cubic rectangular constant of the real \\(\\ell_3^2\\) plane
